text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what's wrong?
If you're having trouble, I'm here to listen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, I spotted Blast Onepiece.
Beside her were a crying child
and a woman who appeared to be the mother.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
B-Blast-san...?
And who might that child with you be...?

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry for making you worry...
I had promised this little one that we'd play at the park.

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the playground equipment is out of order due to construction...
and I can't really think of anywhere else
where they could play to their hearts' content....”

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me then!
I'll help you think of something too!
choice_data_list: If only there were somewhere to hang out besides the park...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, in that case...
How about Tokyo Racecourse?"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~~ totally!! It's close to here,
and there are places to hang out too!!

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
A racetrack... is a place where you race, right?
Is there really a place for kids to play there...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
...If you'd like, would you want to go check it out once?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
What's that... There's a huge dome...tan!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's playground equipment.
Children are free to play in the Kids' Garden
located inside this racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
What should we play?!
Swings, slides, the bouncy dome!
I'm down for whatever you wanna do!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the shape of this swing...!
I know this, it's the one where Umamusume
burst out running at full speed!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Fufu, exactly. This was designed to resemble starting gates, you see. It might give you a taste of what it feels like to be an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of other attractions too.
For instance... the mini bullet train over there.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
Let's see, let's see, what should I play with first...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, no need to rush~!
Come play all of them together with us!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's all have fun together!

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text: To see that girl so happy...! Truly, I don't even know how to thank you...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I'm just glad you're enjoying yourself.
...Um, if you'd like, would you want to
go check out the event over there too?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There is an Umamusume performance show.
I am certain... you would enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Actress Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Here I go~... Hup!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah...!
Amazing, she jumped over such a high vaulting box!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Did that surprise you? That is the jumping power of an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!
So Umamusume aren't just fast runners.
...That's so cool.

text_block_list.name: Actress Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"The next hurdle race is open for kids to participate!
Are there any kids who want a piggyback ride from me~?"

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ! Hey, hey, Mom...!

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes, of course it is.
Be sure to raise your hand with plenty of energy, okay?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Blast-san, Chrono-san!
Thank you, today was so much fun~!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Umamusume are so amazing. ...When I get home, I'm gonna study up on races!

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
There was so much I didn't know, either.
...I'd like to come back here again with this little one.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, by all means.
I'm sure the racetrack will welcome both of you.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Chro~no~! Thanks a million.
Those folks were beaming ear to ear!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No... The pleasure is mine. I'm honored that
the two of you have taken an interest in racing.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because the racecourse is a place... that gives people
a reason to fall in love with racing.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
When people see Umamusume giving their all in a race,
they grow fond of them and start cheering for them—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
That is how the history of racing is woven.
...In every era.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Whether adult or child, anyone can fall in love with racing.
I'm so glad we could convey the appeal of the racecourse like this.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Yeah, yeah, totally!
When people cheer for you,
it fills you right up with energy!
choice_data_list: Chrono really loves the racetrack, huh.
Chrono really loves the racetrack, doesn't she.
I'd love to show you around the other racecourses too...
I'd love to show you around the other racecourses too!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Yeah, yeah, totally!
When people cheer for you,
it fills you right up with energy!
choice_data_list: Chrono really loves the racetrack, huh.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "...Indeed. It is always a pleasure to see people grow fond of the racetrack."

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Then how about we host a tour ourselves!?
Guiding the kids around the racetrack
would definitely be a blast~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
O-On such a large scale...!?
I see... I'll think it over.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes... Each racecourse has its own unique characteristics, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
My top recommendation at Nakayama is the Memorial Walk.
I could gaze at the panels of legendary Umamusume who shaped racing history forever, and then at Ohi—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh!
That's some incredible passion...!
